method: Actual exported compose/aboveText, actual KaTeX JS/CSS/fonts, real Chromium layout and Noto Sans JP; no user material or live service. No forced KaTeX font size, overflow clipping, transforms or scaling. All parent sizes require width containment; normal 16/20px parents require visible glyphs <=14px and box height <=140px. An adversarial 32px parent must record a measured quality candidate when oversized, rather than claiming a balanced pass. The image-height ratio is reported without discarding source text.
scope: Presentation rendering and real DOM inspection only. The anonymous thin-thumbnail placeholder and example divider supply layout context; native uploads, divider insertion and editor transactions are tested separately.
